canonical_project: Monaco Telecom Larvotto Superieur data center
owner: Monaco Telecom / Direction des Travaux Publics
notes: Larvotto Superieur is a 35-apartment public-housing project at 19 Boulevard du Larvotto with a Monaco Telecom data center in lower/subterranean levels. DCD reported 1,550 sqm and a 2027 completion target; ABBA lists 2022-2027; DCmag reported in 2026 that the data-center area is 1,318 sqm with a 2028 objective. MW not disclosed.
